sessions.notes_text:
Contact Summary: Conducted initial intake and consultation over the phone with client Tikita Foster. Explained the 8-week Turn90 program structure, expectations, and compensation. Gathered baseline information regarding housing, ID, transportation, and legal history to begin building a Reentry Navigation plan.

Case Plan Goal Progress: N/A - Initial intake assessment.

Briefcase & Gate 1-4 Updates: 
- Identification: Client has SS card and Birth Certificate. Lacks a State ID. Has a Driver's License but requires SR22 insurance to be valid.
- Housing: Highly precarious. Currently staying with his mother but reports he is "basically homeless" as the arrangement is temporary.
- Transportation: No personal vehicle. Will need to explore public transit (Dial-a-Ride) to access the center.
- Health: Needs replacement prescription glasses (left previous pair while incarcerated). Not currently on any medications.
- Legal/Financial: Owes child support arrears (exact amount unknown) and $700-$1000 in court fees. No active probation or parole.

Referrals/Resources Provided: Discussed "Dial-a-Ride" for Spartanburg transportation. Offered to send temporary job openings while working on Reentry Navigation prerequisites.

Next Steps: Navigator will research Dial-a-Ride options from client's address, identify local housing partners, and assist with securing a State ID and prescription glasses before transitioning client into the full-time program.
